messages:
Lucy: Quick heads up — staging preview shows a 404 on ja/runtime-onboarding.md when clicking the 'スタートガイド' link. looks like a relative path is wrong. pinging docs owners, i'm blocked on localization smoke tests. @Anna?

Anna: thanks for the ping. can you paste the failing URL and the snippet from the file?

Lucy: failing URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/ja/runtime-onboarding -> 404 on the "スタートガイド" link. snippet from the md: 
```
[スタートガイド](../guides/getting-started)
```
should be: 
```
[スタートガイド](/guides/getting-started)
```

Chris: i can open a tiny PR unless this needs l10n coordination first.

Lucy: l10n just needs a heads-up so translators aren't surprised. this is a one-line path fix, frontmatter and keys unchanged. tiny PR is fine.

Anna: ok go ahead @Chris. please tag #i18n in the PR and add a short description: "fix link causing 404 in ja staging preview".

Chris: on it — i'll push branch `fix/ja-onboard-link` and open the PR in ~10m. pinging @Mike for quick CR.

Mike: happy to review, ping me once it's up. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: automated check -> broken-link-scan found 1 failing link in `ja/runtime-onboarding.md` (line 42).

Lucy: quick question — do we need to backport this to an older release branch? our smoke tests run off main only.

Anna: no backport required for small docs fixes unless product asks. we can revisit if customers reference older docs.

Chris: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — one-line md fix. CI green except flaky image job. requesting @Mike for review and @Anna for owner ack.

Mike: reviewing now. small nit: add a short note in the PR body so l10n gets an automated email ("no content change, path fix only").

Chris: added the note and the #i18n tag. assigning to @Mike for review.

Mike: approved, merging. :tada:

Lucy: confirmed staging preview now shows the page and the link works. i'll re-run the localization smoke tests and report back.

Lucy: smoke tests passed end-to-end. closing the loop — no further action required. thanks everyone!
